objective_boundary: Bounded task README hash, not a canonical v13 Project objective.
question: Extract local depth covariance and classify exact saturated anchor-free periodic models.
domain: Finite signed Fourier matrices and periodic cell models, not actual zeta zeros.
assumptions: Generalized cell mean rho=sum m/Q is retained; only rho=1 matches the preceding whole-model normalization.
Quantitative covariance uses exact common-coset centers, or the explicitly supplied cell-preserving phase error; a=0 off pair sites.
The lower nonlinear constant requires kappa_A>0; combining with the signed defect uses A<=2*pi. A<=log 2 gives the rational bound.
Exact equality classification uses m in {0,2} and every occupied center in its own supplied cell, without a small-depth condition.
Local block length is fixed before taking sequence limits; no global uniform phase/depth coherence is inferred.
cannot_imply: No proof of RH or unconditional zero-proportion improvement.
